title: Three Years and One Short Ledger
subtitle: 公益事业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 公益事业（人与社会·社会服务与公益）
meta: 主题语境：公益事业（人与社会·社会服务与公益）　|　核心词汇：fund　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fund 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the secretary ① set up a fund that no officer in the office would have counted, and he said the setting up was the whole of the year. The ② fund, meaning the money itself and not the account, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a fund, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ fund in that office had the same short ledger beside it, and the ④ fund at the far desk, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fund, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the secretary said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fund was the whole of the matter, meaning the store and not the money. The ⑥ fund, meaning the store and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; fund, he said, is either something you set up or the only word that means both money and a store. He said the store is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ fund had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short ledger. The ⑧ fund of the whole thing, the secretary wrote in June, was one office and three years of counting; fund, he said, is either the one at the far desk or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fund I remember is the one counted in the plan, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ fund, my mother said in 1975, is the only one that improves by being counted; every fund, she said, is a store that has agreed to look like money. She said the store was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 基金；专款（指办公室里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 基金（指那一笔本身，与账户相对）
C. 固定搭配：set up a fund 设立一项基金
D. n. 基金（指留给孩子们的那一笔）
E. n. 基金（抽象总称，指一间办公室的设基金之事）
F. n. 基金（指计划里写到、被清点过的那一笔）
G. n. 储备；蕴藏（a fund of knowledge，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 储备（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: set up a fund that no officer in the office would have counted
The fund, meaning the money itself and not the account
the fund at the far desk
the fund was the whole of the matter
the fund had become a line in a plan
The fund of the whole thing
A fund, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: set up a fund 意为“设立一项基金”，1964 年那位干事设立了一笔办公室里没有一位官员肯清点的基金。
fund 意为“基金”，指那一笔本身而不是账户，它经过了三年而在簿子上没有被清点。
fund 意为“基金”，指办公室里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一本短短的账簿。
fund 意为“基金”，指留给孩子们的那一笔，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fund 意为“储备、蕴藏”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份储备就是那件事的全部。
fund 意为“储备”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那笔基金，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fund 意为“基金”，指计划里写到、被清点过的那一笔，到 1971 年这一笔成了计划里的一行。
fund 意为“基金”，干事六月写道，整件事的设基金之事是一间办公室和三年的清点。
fund 意为“基金”，我记得的是计划里清点过的那一笔，1973 年结束了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一笔。
fund 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，一笔基金是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的东西。
